label: For organisations
title: Culture sessions for teams
summary: Painting hours with named artists, regional food stories and short introductions to Indian thought, for offsites, festival weeks and onboarding.

choices: A culture session for a team
form.messageLabel: Tell us about your team and what you have in mind
form.messageHint: Roughly how many people, online or in person, the city, and any dates.

label: Commission a piece
title: Commission original work
summary: Ask a named artist to make something for you: a painting for a new home or a gift for a wedding. The artist sets the price.

form.messageLabel: Describe the piece you have in mind
form.messageHint: The occasion, the size or the space it is for, a rough budget and when you need it.

label: Gifting
title: Gifts with a story
summary: Festive and corporate gift boxes from named makers, each with a card that tells their story. Made to pre-order, never mass-stocked.

form.messageLabel: Tell us what you are looking for
form.messageHint: How many gifts, a budget per gift, and the date they need to arrive.

label: Journeys
title: Small-group cultural journeys
summary: A few days with a tradition and the people who keep it, travelling slowly in a small group.

form.messageHint: When you could travel, who you would come with, and what you would most like to experience.

label: Family stories
title: Keep your family's stories
summary: We record a grandparent's memories, recipes and rituals, and turn them into a printed booklet and an audio keepsake.

choices: Yes, for a birthday or anniversary
No, it is for our own family
form.messageLabel: Tell us about the person whose stories you would like to keep
form.messageHint: Who they are to you, where they live, the languages they speak and any date you have in mind.

label: Coming drops
title: Small seasonal drops
summary: A few makers at a time, a limited number of pieces and the full story behind each one. Join the list to hear first.

form.choiceLabel: What would you most like to see?
form.messageLabel: Anything you would love us to find?
form.messageHint: A craft, a region or a maker you admire.
Your craft, where you work, how long you have practised, and a link to photographs of your work if you have one.
